name: app-icon

prompt.purpose: A finished, unmistakably high-contrast application icon for Octa Structure Studio, a 3D studio made of truncated-octahedron cells. One square 1024 x 1024 image. This replaces a pale mint wireframe icon that disappeared in the macOS Dock.
prompt.subject: One bold geometric wireframe truncated octahedron, centered and large. Preserve the recognizable Octa emblem: a symmetric octagonal outer silhouette with a flat top and bottom, slanted corner faces, and an elongated hexagonal face in the middle connected cleanly to the outer corners. It should read as one faceted 3D cell, not a cube and not a random network. Only visible meaningful structural edges; no hidden-edge clutter.
prompt.layout: The outer wireframe silhouette occupies approximately 72 percent of the canvas width and height, with generous equal black margins. Center the mark exactly. No text anywhere. No badge or secondary symbol. The geometry is front-facing and balanced, with a subtle dimensional reading from its facets.
prompt.style: Minimal premium geometric neon logo. Thick, perfectly clean fluorescent strokes with rounded joins. Crisp luminous cores, restrained local glow. Clear and instantly recognizable at 32, 64 and 128 pixels. Shape and contrast are more important than effects.
prompt.palette: Truly black #000000 background filling the entire square canvas, fully opaque. Main outline is extremely bright fluorescent acid green #B6FF00 and laser lime #8DFF00, with small electric mint #00FFAE accents on a few inner edges. Keep a bright lime core through every stroke. Interior faces remain black or almost black, never white or grey.
prompt.light: The lines emit neon light with a tightly controlled glow extending no farther than one quarter of a stroke width. The black field stays black. No broad haze, no bloom cloud, no soft focus.
prompt.technical: 1024 x 1024 opaque PNG; edge-to-edge solid black canvas; large clean geometry; stroke width roughly 28 to 34 pixels at this size; no thin hairline details. Do not draw a rounded app tile or an outer border: the native icon packaging will provide its shape.
prompt.exclude: No words, letters, numbers, watermark, signature, white background, grey background, pastel green, washed-out colors, chrome frame, outer icon border, reflections, gradients across the background, cast shadow, floor, perspective mockup, screenshot, multiple icons, visual clutter, or clipped logo.

prompt_text:
PURPOSE: A finished, unmistakably high-contrast application icon for Octa Structure Studio, a 3D studio made of truncated-octahedron cells. One square 1024 x 1024 image. This replaces a pale mint wireframe icon that disappeared in the macOS Dock.
SUBJECT: One bold geometric wireframe truncated octahedron, centered and large. Preserve the recognizable Octa emblem: a symmetric octagonal outer silhouette with a flat top and bottom, slanted corner faces, and an elongated hexagonal face in the middle connected cleanly to the outer corners. It should read as one faceted 3D cell, not a cube and not a random network. Only visible meaningful structural edges; no hidden-edge clutter.
LAYOUT: The outer wireframe silhouette occupies approximately 72 percent of the canvas width and height, with generous equal black margins. Center the mark exactly. No text anywhere. No badge or secondary symbol. The geometry is front-facing and balanced, with a subtle dimensional reading from its facets.
STYLE: Minimal premium geometric neon logo. Thick, perfectly clean fluorescent strokes with rounded joins. Crisp luminous cores, restrained local glow. Clear and instantly recognizable at 32, 64 and 128 pixels. Shape and contrast are more important than effects.
PALETTE: Truly black #000000 background filling the entire square canvas, fully opaque. Main outline is extremely bright fluorescent acid green #B6FF00 and laser lime #8DFF00, with small electric mint #00FFAE accents on a few inner edges. Keep a bright lime core through every stroke. Interior faces remain black or almost black, never white or grey.
LIGHT: The lines emit neon light with a tightly controlled glow extending no farther than one quarter of a stroke width. The black field stays black. No broad haze, no bloom cloud, no soft focus.
TECHNICAL: 1024 x 1024 opaque PNG; edge-to-edge solid black canvas; large clean geometry; stroke width roughly 28 to 34 pixels at this size; no thin hairline details. Do not draw a rounded app tile or an outer border: the native icon packaging will provide its shape.
EXCLUDE: No words, letters, numbers, watermark, signature, white background, grey background, pastel green, washed-out colors, chrome frame, outer icon border, reflections, gradients across the background, cast shadow, floor, perspective mockup, screenshot, multiple icons, visual clutter, or clipped logo.

derivatives.processing: Resize to 896x896, apply an antialiased rounded-rectangle alpha mask with a 190px corner radius, center on a transparent 1024x1024 canvas (64px padding). The tile background remains opaque black.
